description: Installed November 2018 as the first 'aeronave insignia' of the FAC's Tramo del Aire on the city's Corredor Verde linear park outside the base; the FAC planned three more aircraft and a helicopter there. Serial not established; FAC cleanup report November 2024 confirms the corridor is maintained.
